description: Aparcamiento para personas con movilidad reducida en Tarragona is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by google.com. Parking for people with reduced mobility in Tarragona is a dataset that shows a map with the address and location of all the parking lots reserved for people with reduced mobility in Tarragona. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Parking for people with reduced mobility in Tarragona" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Tarragona, mobilitat reduïda, parking slot, reduced mobility, movilidad reducida, aparcamiento. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
